lines.say: Room Four is where they keep the other me.
I went back to the base. Room Four was waiting.
I tapped three times. The door unlocked itself.
Rows of cots. Old men asleep on every one.
Every one had my face. Every one, a different age.
Each cot had a tag. A year.
One cot was empty. The tag had my name.
The old man stood behind me. That one is yours.
Don't sleep, he said. Not for one second.
